name: Gap Up Today
text: Nifty 500 stocks that opened at least 3% above the previous close today
needs: screen mode (F1); a list of stocks, not a strategy

name: Midcap Momentum
text: Nifty Midcap 150 stocks with 3 month return above 20% and price above the 50 day moving average
needs: screen mode (F1); a list of stocks, not a strategy

name: FII Favourites
text: Stocks where FII holding went up for 3 quarters in a row and market cap is above ₹10,000 Cr
needs: screen mode (F1); a list of stocks, not a strategy

name: Consistent Profit Growers
text: Stocks with net profit growth above 10% in each of the last 5 financial years and ROE above 15%
needs: screen mode (F1); a list of stocks, not a strategy

name: Debt Free Compounders
text: Debt free stocks with 5 year sales growth above 15%, 5 year profit growth above 15% and ROCE above 20%
needs: screen mode (F1); a list of stocks, not a strategy

name: Low PEG Growth
text: Stocks with PEG ratio below 1, 3 year EPS growth above 20% and market cap above ₹1,000 Cr
needs: screen mode (F1); a list of stocks, not a strategy

name: Undervalued Tech
text: IT sector stocks with market cap above ₹5,000 Cr, P/E below the sector median, ROE above 15% and debt to equity below 0.5
needs: screen mode (F1); a list of stocks, not a strategy

name: 52 Week High
text: Nifty 500 stocks with LTP within 5% of their 52-week high and today's volume at least 1.5 times the 20-day average volume
needs: screen mode (F1); a list of stocks, not a strategy

name: Bollinger Squeeze
text: Stocks where Bollinger Band width is at its lowest level in the last 6 months
needs: screen mode (F1); a list of stocks, not a strategy

name: Cash Rich Small Caps
text: Small cap stocks where cash and investments are above 30% of market cap and debt to equity is below 0.2
needs: screen mode (F1); a list of stocks, not a strategy

name: Quality at Low
text: Nifty 200 stocks trading within 5% of their 52 week low with ROE above 12% and price above EMA 20
needs: screen mode (F1); a list of stocks, not a strategy

name: Pharma Growth
text: Pharma stocks with 3 year sales growth above 12%, operating margin above 18% and P/E below 35
needs: screen mode (F1); a list of stocks, not a strategy

name: High Dividend Yield
text: Stocks with dividend yield above 3% and market cap above ₹2,000 Cr
needs: screen mode (F1); a list of stocks, not a strategy

name: MACD Bullish Cross
text: Nifty 500 stocks where MACD crossed above the signal line today and price is above the 200 day moving average
needs: screen mode (F1); a list of stocks, not a strategy

name: Golden Crossovers
text: Stocks where the 50 day moving average crossed above the 200 day moving average in the last 5 trading days
needs: screen mode (F1); a list of stocks, not a strategy

name: Above All EMA
text: Nifty 500 stocks trading above the 20, 50, 100 and 200 day EMA
needs: screen mode (F1); a list of stocks, not a strategy

name: Promoter Buying
text: Stocks where promoter holding increased by at least 1% in the latest quarter and promoter pledge is below 5%
needs: screen mode (F1); a list of stocks, not a strategy

name: Hourly Momentum
text: On BAJFINANCE hourly bars, buy when RSI crosses above 60 and the close is above the 20-hour EMA. Exit when the close falls below the 20-hour EMA. Hold overnight. Backtest the last 2 years.
needs: no stop loss given -- must ask, never invent one

name: 9:20 Short Straddle
text: Sell the NIFTY weekly ATM straddle at 09:20 with a 25% stop on each leg. Square off at 15:15. Backtest the last 1 year.
needs: options (Phase 2)

name: Bull Put Spread
text: At 09:30, sell the NIFTY weekly put 200 points below spot and buy the put 400 points below. Exit at 50% of the credit received or at 15:15. Backtest the last 1 year.
needs: options (Phase 2)

name: Gated by Nifty Trend
text: On TITAN hourly bars, buy when RSI crosses above 55 and exit when RSI falls below 45. Only take entries while NIFTY 50 is above its 200-day SMA. Stop 2%, hold overnight. Backtest the last 3 years.
needs: a NIFTY 200-day SMA trend filter on a stock (cross-instrument)

name: Stochastic Oversold Turn
text: On BHARTIARTL 15-minute bars, buy when Stochastic %K crosses above %D below the 20 level. Exit when %K goes above 80. Stop 0.8%, square off at 15:15. Backtest the last 1 year.
needs: Stochastic %K/%D (A6)

name: Bollinger Band Bounce
text: On INFY hourly bars, buy when the close crosses back above the lower Bollinger Band. Exit when the close touches the middle band. Stop 2%, hold overnight. Backtest the last 2 years.
needs: hourly bars, 'hold overnight', 'backtest the last N years' (A3)

name: Opening Range Breakout
text: On HDFCBANK 5-minute bars, buy when the close breaks above the high of the first 15 minutes. Stop at the low of the opening range, target 1.2%, square off at 15:15. Backtest the last 1 year.
needs: asks once-a-day or every time, then reads with the opening-range low as its stop (2026-10-16; tests/test_level_stop.py)

name: Supertrend Swing
text: On TCS daily bars, buy when Supertrend turns bullish and exit when it turns bearish. Backtest the last 5 years.
needs: no stop loss given -- must ask, never invent one

name: Gap Down Put Buy
text: On NIFTY 5-minute bars, when the day opens more than 0.5% below the previous close, buy the weekly ATM put at 09:30 if price is still below the open. Stop 30%, target 60%. Square off at 15:15. Backtest the last 6 months.
needs: a gap at the open and an entry time (2026-10-16)

name: Donchian Breakout Swing
text: On MARUTI daily bars, buy when the close is above the highest high of the last 20 days. Exit when the close falls below the lowest low of the last 10 days. Backtest the last 5 years.
needs: no stop loss given -- must ask, never invent one

name: Weekly Put Sell to Expiry
text: Every Monday at 09:30, sell the NIFTY weekly put 300 points below spot and hold it to expiry. Backtest the last 1 year.
needs: options (Phase 2)

name: MACD with Daily Trend
text: On AXISBANK 15-minute bars, buy when MACD crosses above its signal line and the daily close is above the 50-day SMA. Stop 1%, target 2%, square off at 15:15. Backtest the last 1 year.
needs: a daily SMA on an intraday chart (A6)

name: VWAP Reclaim
text: On SBIN 5-minute bars, buy when the close crosses above VWAP and RSI is above 50. Exit when the close falls back below VWAP. Stop 0.6%, square off at 15:15. Backtest the last 1 year.
needs: 'falls back below' wording; test period wording (A3)

name: Previous Day Low Put Buy
text: On BANKNIFTY 15-minute bars, buy the monthly ATM put when a candle closes below the previous day's low. Stop 30%, target 50% on the premium. Square off at 15:15. Backtest the last 6 months.
needs: options (Phase 2)

name: Golden Cross
text: On ASIANPAINT daily bars, buy when the 50-day SMA crosses above the 200-day SMA and sell when it crosses back below. Backtest the last 5 years.
needs: no stop loss given -- must ask, never invent one

name: Straddle with Re-entry
text: Sell the NIFTY weekly ATM straddle at 09:20 with a 25% stop on each leg, and re-enter a leg once if it gets stopped out. Square off at 15:15. Backtest the last 1 year.
needs: options (Phase 2)

name: Iron Condor
text: At 09:30, sell a NIFTY weekly iron condor with short strikes 200 points out and wings 100 points beyond them. Exit at 50% of the credit received or at 15:15. Backtest the last 1 year.
needs: options (Phase 2)

name: Iron Butterfly
text: At 09:20, sell the NIFTY weekly ATM call and put and buy wings 200 points on either side. Take profit at 40% of the net credit. Square off at 15:15. Backtest the last 1 year.
needs: options (Phase 2)

name: Opening Range Call Buy
text: On NIFTY 5-minute bars, buy the weekly ATM call when a candle closes above the high of the first 15 minutes. Stop 30%, target 60% on the premium. Square off at 15:15. Backtest the last 6 months.
needs: options (Phase 2)

name: High IV Straddle
text: Sell the NIFTY weekly ATM straddle at 09:20 only on days when IV percentile is above 70. Stop at 30% of the premium collected. Square off at 15:15. Backtest the last 1 year.
needs: options (Phase 2)

name: Bollinger Breakout
text: On ADANIPORTS 15-minute bars, buy when the close breaks above the upper Bollinger Band. Stop 1%, target 2%, square off at 15:15. Backtest the last 1 year.
needs: 'breaks above' wording; test period wording (A3)

name: RSI Dip Buy
text: On HINDUNILVR 15-minute bars, buy when RSI crosses above 30 and the close is above the 200-bar EMA. Stop 0.7%, target 1.4%, square off at 15:15. Backtest the last 1 year.
needs: '200-bar EMA' wording; test period wording (A3)

name: Sensex Straddle
text: Sell the SENSEX weekly ATM straddle at 09:20 with a 30% stop on each leg. Square off at 15:15. Backtest the last 6 months.
needs: options (Phase 2)

name: RSI Momentum Call
text: On BANKNIFTY 15-minute bars, buy the monthly ATM call when RSI crosses above 60. Stop 30%, target 50% on the premium. Square off at 15:15. Backtest the last 6 months.
needs: options (Phase 2)

name: EMA Crossover with VWAP
text: On ICICIBANK 15-minute bars, buy when the 9 EMA crosses above the 21 EMA while the close is above VWAP. Stop 0.8%, target 1.6%, square off at 15:15. Backtest the last 1 year.
needs: 'while' joining conditions; test period wording (A3)

name: RSI Pullback in Uptrend
text: On RELIANCE hourly bars, buy when RSI is between 45 and 60 and the close is above the 200-hour simple moving average. Exit when RSI goes above 70 or the close falls below the 200-hour average. Hold overnight. Backtest the last 2 years.
needs: no stop loss given -- must ask, never invent one
